'''Reo Myershi''' was an ancestor of King [[Paitar]] of [[Arafel]]. The [[Age]] of his life is unknown.  

== History ==
Reo alone had heard a [[Reo Myershi's prophecy|Foretelling]] from an [[Aes Sedai]] of his own family line about [[Tellindal Tirraso]] and the [[Dragon Reborn]]. He ordered the words to be preserved and being passed secretly to his heirs. It was passed from monarch to monarch in the [[Arafellin]] royal line until his descendant [[Paitar Nachiman]] asked for the answer from Rand al'Thor, the Dragon Reborn.{{ref/book|13|51}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Reo Myershi}}

== Trivia ==
* Reo Myershi is named for Reo Meyer, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
